title: The Swamp Observatory Eco-monsters of the Future Swamp

events.t: The Swamp Observatory: Eco-monsters of the Future Swamp
events.q: The Swamp Observatory: Eco-monsters of the Future Swamp (2022-2025)

events.n: initially created for the planning of a new sustainable city on Gotland
events.q: The Swamp Observatory was initially created as an artistic contribution to the planning of a new sustainable city in a decommissioned military area of the Swedish island Gotland in the Baltic Sea.

events.who: Public Art Agency Sweden and Baltic Art Center
events.n: commissioned; curated by Helena Selder, produced by Ana Norberg
events.q: The Swamp Observatory: Eco-Monsters was commissioned by the Public Art Agency Sweden and Baltic Art Center and curated by Helena Selder, produced by Ana Norberg

events.v: Lithuanian Pavilion, Venice Biennale Architecture Exhibition
events.n: further developed for; curated by Jurga Daubaraitė and Jonas Žukauskas
events.q: further developed for the Children’s Forest Pavilion curated by Jurga Daubaraitė and Jonas Žukauskas for the Lithuanian Pavilion at the Venice Biennale Architecture Exhibition 2023
